title: 전표 인쇄 여부의 표시·채널·이력 저장 계약 조사

sourceFindings.finding: List tooltip first checks alias-key property availability and hides display value when unavailable. C-Portal menu selects external print information; other menus select internal information. Unknown/hidden information must not be labelled definitively unprinted.
sourceFindings.limitations: This display helper does not define permission rules, list filter options, original icons, or server history persistence.

sourceFindings.finding: Reads prefix/print_datetime and prefix/user. Missing datetime returns empty string. Otherwise datetime_timezone resolver formats timestamp and user is combined into tooltip text.
sourceFindings.limitations: No writer, browser cancellation policy, retention, first-versus-last print, counts, complete event log, or physical printer completion is proved.

sourceFindings.finding: Print information list action maps print to common$ISlipLinkUserAction. Treat clicking print information as an action route, not a safe read-only history popup.
sourceFindings.limitations: Descriptor alone does not establish which inventory menu uses it, runtime printing success or saved history.

sourceFindings.finding: Legacy common source declares ActionIdentifier for /api/app.common/action/SavePrintHistoryAction. Only static declaration was analyzed; no endpoint request was made.
sourceFindings.limitations: Declaration is not proof of a dispatched write, triggering event, payload, authorization, actual storage or physical output.

ownOperatingComparison.finding: Current printPage and selected-request batch call window.print with temporary style/render handling; these paths do not create a durable printed-status record. Existing request print tests cover preview/print-stub and preservation, not original print-history parity. No status field or automatic afterprint history was added.
ownOperatingComparison.absenceScope: Inspected operating print paths and named schema files only; not a full ERP absence claim.

remainingGates: Exact024 full body and actual readonly print-status column/filter or history view; original print/info action not executed.
Original trigger across preview, print dialog cancellation, PDF/export, failed/repeated and multi-slip print; internal/C-Portal channel and user/time permissions.
Server authority, payload, retention, existing-data migration/default unknown state, concurrent printing and preservation.
Physical output cannot be inferred from window.print return or afterprint. No unverified printed boolean was created.
